title: Qui appelle ? Que cherchez-vous ?
summary: Ask about a person, a thing or a choice by deciding whether the unknown element is the subject or object.
objectives: Distinguish subject and object questions with qui and que.
Use qu'est-ce qui for a thing as subject.
Agree quel in questions and exclamations.

sources.label: Public A2 index: topic-coverage reference only

sections.title: Is the unknown person doing the action?
paragraphs: If you ask who performs the action, qui itself is the subject: qui appelle ? You can also say qui est-ce qui appelle ? No extra subject pronoun is needed. If a known subject acts on an unknown person, ask an object question: qui appelez-vous ? or qui est-ce que vous appelez ? Conversational vous appelez qui ? is also possible.

For a thing as direct object, use que + inversion (que cherchez-vous ?), qu'est-ce que + ordinary word order (qu'est-ce que vous cherchez ?) or conversational vous cherchez quoi ? Que becomes qu' before a vowel. For a thing as subject, use qu'est-ce qui + verb: qu'est-ce qui bloque la porte ? Do not add a separate il for the thing already represented by qui.
If the verb requires a preposition, keep it: à qui parlez-vous ? The ordinary forms here use singular verbs after subject qui/qu'est-ce qui when the answer's number is not specified.
points: Person subject: qui / qui est-ce qui. Person object: qui / qui est-ce que. Thing subject: qu'est-ce qui. Thing object: que / qu'est-ce que / final quoi according to construction.

examples.note: The unknown person is the subject.
Vous is the subject; the unknown person is the object of attendre.

examples.english: What are you looking for in this file?
examples.note: Que is the object with inversion.
The unknown thing is the subject.

mistakes.why: The unknown person is the subject, so the last word is qui.

sections.title: A noun after the question word
paragraphs: Quel introduces a noun and agrees with it: quel (masculine singular), quelle (feminine singular), quels (masculine plural), quelles (feminine plural). It asks which or what: quelle adresse, quels horaires. With être, agreement still follows the noun identified: quelle est votre adresse ? Not every English what becomes que.

The same forms introduce exclamations: quelle surprise ! means 'What a surprise!' French uses quel directly before the noun, without an extra un/une. Tone or punctuation separates a question from an exclamation; the agreement is the same.
points: Quel billet ? Quelle place ? Quels documents ? Quelles dates ? The four forms sound alike, so the noun guides the spelling.

examples.note: Masculine plural question; apportés agrees with the preceding direct object.

examples.english: What a good idea! What beautiful drawings!

mistakes.why: Do not copy the English article after what a.

practice.prompt: Supply qui or que: Qui est-ce ___ frappe à la porte ?
practice.explanation: The unknown person is the subject.

practice.prompt: Supply qui or que: Qui est-ce ___ tu invites ?
practice.explanation: Tu is the subject; the person invited is the object.

practice.prompt: Ask what is happening with qu'est-ce qui and se passer in the present.
practice.explanation: The question asks about the thing happening.

practice.prompt: Supply quel in the correct form: ___ heure est-il ?
Ask who works here using the short subject qui form and travailler.
practice.explanation: Qui is the subject; no inversion is needed.

practice.prompt: Ask whom vous invitez using qui and inversion. No other words.
practice.explanation: The unknown person is the object.

practice.prompt: Ask what vous voulez using que and inversion. No other words.
practice.explanation: Que is the object before inversion.

practice.prompt: Complete with the full subject-thing question expression: ___ bloque la sortie ?
practice.explanation: The unknown thing performs the blocking.

practice.prompt: Supply the final question word: Vous préparez ___ ? Ask what.
practice.explanation: In the conversational final position, use quoi.

practice.prompt: Supply quel in the correct form: ___ dates préférez-vous ?
Supply quel in the correct form: ___ est votre numéro ?
Turn une belle journée into a French exclamation beginning with the appropriate form of quel.
Supply qui or que: Qu'est-ce ___ vous avez acheté ?
practice.explanation: Vous is the subject; the unknown thing is the object.

practice.prompt: Supply quel for an exclamation: ___ beaux cadeaux !
Ask who called using qui est-ce qui and appeler in the passé composé. No other words.
practice.explanation: Qui represents the subject of a appelé.

production_task.prompt: You are organising a group activity. Ask who will help, which dates suit people and what you need to bring; add one natural appreciative exclamation.
production_task.model_answer: Qui peut aider samedi ? Quelles dates préférez-vous si samedi ne convient pas ? Que devons-nous apporter ? Quelle bonne idée de partager le matériel !
production_task.translation: Who can help on Saturday? Which dates do you prefer if Saturday does not work? What should we bring? What a good idea to share the equipment!
rubric: Distinguish subject qui from object que.
Do not add an article after exclamative quel.
